virals_narrative: Google's launches carried the watchlist again. Logan Kilpatrick's Gemini 4 Hydrogen post was the biggest new one at 1.88M views and 10.5K likes in about 18 hours, his 'What should we ship next?' pulled 1,965 replies in under 7 hours, and the Decision 1 launch kept climbing to 777K. Aaron Levie rode the Hydrogen launch with Box's own eval results (83K). Greg Isenberg's 'Status symbols today' list hit 437K with 5.8K bookmarks, and his Grok Bot setup post from two days ago is now past 2M. Guillermo Rauch's agents-era frameworks question got 65K and 657 bookmarks, and Dharmesh Shah's HubSpot refounding story got 48K. Sam Altman, Andrej Karpathy, Yann LeCun, and Alex Hormozi had no qualifying originals. For Aubric: fast, cheap frontier models remove the speed and cost arguments against checking every ad, and the 'what should we ship next' format is an easy way to crowdsource which checks matter most.

drafts.angle: Fast models, fast reviews (rides @OfficialLoganK's Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch, 1.88M, and @levie's borrowed-proof eval post)
drafts.draft_en:
Fast models just changed the math on ad review.

When a capable model answers in a second, checking every creative before it ships stops being a bottleneck.

Image, video, audio, copy. Brand rules, legal claims, platform policy. Approve, fix, or block, before the media spend goes out.

We'll be testing Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Aubric's checks this week and I'll share what we find.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical. Open on a timer starting at 0.0s, then cut to one ad dropping into the Aubric queue and getting an APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK badge before the timer passes 1 second. Repeat fast for 10 ads. End card: 'Review is no longer the slow step.' Only post the eval follow-up if you actually run it.

drafts.angle: Ask the crowd (rides @OfficialLoganK's 'What should we ship next?', 1,965 replies in under 7 hours)
drafts.draft_en:
Marketers and brand teams: what's the one ad mistake you never want to ship again?

We're picking what Aubric checks for next.
drafts.video_tip: No video needed; the format works as plain text. If you want one, record a 10s selfie clip asking the question straight to camera and pin the best replies as a follow-up thread tomorrow.

drafts.angle: Status-symbol list (rides @gregisenberg's 'Status symbols today', 437K and 5.8K bookmarks)
drafts.draft_en:
Marketing status symbols in 2026:

- Every ad checked before it ships, not after it gets flagged
- Legal signs off in minutes, not weeks
- Zero ad-account suspensions this year
- Brand guidelines a machine can actually read
- Knowing which of your 1,000 AI variants is true
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical, text-only: each bullet pops in on a beat over a plain background, with the last line held for 3 seconds. Small 'Aubric' tag in the final frame only. Keep it as low-production as Greg's list post.
